---
title: "Matchers"
---

The AST matcher vocabulary for [style rules](../guide/styleguide.qmd). Compose with `&`, `|`,
`~`, refine with `.where(...)`, and run with `.over(tree)` or `.violations(tree)`. Import as
`from captain_hook.style import matchers as M`. Every entry is in the
[matchers reference](../reference/matchers.qmd).

## 🧱 Node types

**M.cls** / **M.func** / **M.definition** — class defs, function defs, or either
**M.call** — call expressions
**M.imports** — `import` and `from … import`
**M.assignment** — `x = …` and `x: T = …`
**M.control_flow** — `if` / `for` / `while` / `with` / `try` / `except`
**M.type_checking** — `if TYPE_CHECKING:` blocks
**M.kind(*types)** — any of the given `ast` node types

## 📞 Calls & references

**M.calls(name)** — a call to the bare-name function `name`
```python
M.calls("zip")
```

**M.kwarg(name)** — a call passing keyword argument `name`
**M.ref(name)** — a bare-name reference, like `Any` inside an annotation

## 🏷️ Names

**M.named(pattern)** — a class/func/assignment/param whose name matches a regex
**M.private** — single-leading-underscore names (not dunder)
**M.dunder** — `__dunder__` names
**M.constant** — `SCREAMING_SNAKE` names

## 🧬 Annotations

**M.annotated(inner=None)** — an annotated variable, parameter, or return
**M.forward_ref** — string forward references inside annotations

## 📍 Position

**M.under(other)** — any ancestor matches `other`
**M.child_of(other)** — the immediate parent matches `other`
**M.following(boundary)** — a statement after the first sibling matching `boundary`

## 🔗 Combine & run

**a & b** · **a | b** · **~a** — both, either, negate
**a.where(pred)** — refine with a node-local predicate
**m.over(tree)** — yield every matching node
**m.violations(tree)** — yield a `Violation` per match
**m.diff(pre, post)** — matches in `post` absent from `pre`, for diff rules
**m.exists(tree)** — whether any node matches

## A worked rule

```python
from captain_hook.style import StyleRule, matchers as M

class NoNestedImports(StyleRule):
    """Lazy imports go at the top of the function body, not inside if/for/try."""
    match = M.imports & M.child_of(M.control_flow) & ~M.under(M.type_checking)
```
